description: Removes a contact ID from a Cognigy.AI contact profile. Use this when a user identifier should no longer be associated with a profile. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to remove.

contactId.description: The contact ID to remove from the profile

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without removing. Set to false to actually remove.

profileId.description: The contact profile ID to modify

name: remove_contact_id
